responsibility: Converts a detected SESE-based SCoP from GIMPLE/scalar-evolution form into Graphite’s polyhedral isl model. It extracts affine expressions from trees and chrecs, builds parameter contexts, iteration domains, iterator sets, memory/scalar access maps for data references, and constructs the original schedule that reflects the execution order of polyhedral basic blocks and surrounding loop nest structure. Its top-level build_poly_scop routine is the lowering step from GCC loop/SESE analysis into the isl objects consumed by dependence analysis and schedule optimization.
